paper.title: Identification, Semiparametric Efficiency, and Quadruply Robust Estimation in Mediation Analysis with Treatment-Induced Confounding
paper.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
paper.source_locator: Author accepted manuscript §4.1, “Binary C and M”, PDF p.17; https://par.nsf.gov/servlets/purl/10300663.; adaptation: bundled SCIENTIFIC_SPEC.md and nie_standard_v1/generators.py::_draw

mechanism.name: Standard NIE1 adaptation: xia binary

generation_equations.label: adapted structural equations
generation_equations.expression:
x=c["x_sd"]*r.standard_normal((n,1))
a=r.binomial(1,expit(c["a_logit_intercept"]+c["a_logit_x"]*x[:,0]))
if s=="xia_binary": m=r.binomial(1,expit(c["m_logit_intercept"]+c["m_logit_a"]*a+c["m_logit_x"]*x[:,0]))[:,None]
        else: m=(c["m_intercept"]+c["m_a"]*a+c["m_x"]*x[:,0]+c["m_sd"]*r.standard_normal(n))[:,None]
y=c["y_intercept"]+c["y_a"]*a+(c["y_m"]+c["y_am"]*a)*m[:,0]+c["y_x"]*x[:,0]+c["y_sd"]*r.standard_normal(n)
return x,a,m,y,["binary" if s=="xia_binary" else "continuous"],["continuous"],"continuous"

observed_variables.name: Y
observed_variables.description: Observed outcome; not an oracle target

mechanism.sampling: IID observations at a fixed structural configuration; separate mechanism and observation seeds.
assumptions: Independent exogenous structural errors and iid units conditional on fixed configuration.
No treatment-induced mediator-outcome confounder remains in the adapted SEM.
Causal identification additionally requires consistency, exchangeability/cross-world conditions and treatment/mediator support; treatment randomization alone is insufficient.

estimand.name: NIE
estimand.definition: NIE = E[Y(1,M(1))-Y(1,M(0))] in the adapted fixed-SEM superpopulation, jointly intervening on the complete mediator vector.

truth.expression: NIE = E[Y(1,M(1))-Y(1,M(0))] in the adapted fixed-SEM superpopulation, jointly intervening on the complete mediator vector.
truth.derivation: gauss_hermite_80: 80-node Gaussian quadrature of the mediator probability contrast times (y_m+y_am).

adaptations: Remove C and its effects in Y structurally: y_c=y_ac=0. Preserve the original marginal M law and A-M interaction. Recompute NIE1 rather than reuse source NDE truth.
New complete-data superpopulation NIE1 target; original records/estimands are retained separately.
